eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Owyhee, ID; at 4:09 PM on JUL 26, 2026 Effective until 6:09 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Owyhee County has issued a civil emergency alert for the Jordan Valley Area in Idaho. Big Grass Fire is uncontained and moving rapidly to the south and southwest direction. Pleasant Valley Flink Creek Road including the town of Triangle and Triangle Reservoir is in a Ready Stage 1. Be prepared to evacuate. Contact Owyhee County at 2 0 8 4 9 5 1 2 0 5 for additional information. This message was sent by the Idaho State Communications Center and is now concluded. If evacuation occurs directions: Take Bachman Grade Road to Oreana.
